name: Native-beta hedged single-token trend
hypothesis: Buy the token's positive residual breakout and short the measured native-coin beta using an eligible instrument.
spec: Setup: A token may trend independently of its host asset. Entry: Buy the token's positive residual breakout and short the measured native-coin beta using an eligible instrument. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on residual reversal or unstable beta/hedge conditions. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs hedgeable short legs or float estimates for memecoins
